name: i18n-mod
description: Localize supported Claude Code UI hints with selectable, extensible language packs.

language.title: UI language / JSON language pack
language.description: Language code or JSON file path; relative paths resolve under this plugin. en preserves the original UI.

turnDurationMode.title: Turn duration mode
turnDurationMode.description: Native preserves the host footer. Custom uses an independent elapsed-time line without native completion time or statistics.

turnDurationVisible.title: Show custom turn duration
turnDurationVisible.description: Only controls the custom elapsed-time line; does not change the host's native visibility setting.

turnDurationSpacing.title: Custom turn duration spacing
turnDurationSpacing.description: Compact adds no top margin; separated adds one row. Only applies in custom mode.
